name: Chocolate, Peanut Butter, Banana & Date Oatmeal Protein Bites

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Line two large baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Peel bananas, break into chunks, and place in a medium bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
Roughly chop dates. Add to the bowl with the banana along with eggs, peanut butter, and maple syrup. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup medjool dates, pitted
3 eggs
½ cup natural peanut butter
3 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Add oats, protein powder, cocoa powder, cinnamon, and salt to the bowl. Stir once more to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cup oats, quick cooking
3 servings vanilla whey-based protein powder (containing 20 grams protein/serving)
3 tbsp cocoa powder
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a ¼-cup measure, scoop batter onto the baking sheets, leaving some space between. Use the back of a spoon to spread each "bite" into a 3-inch circle. Place in the oven and bake until just firm to the touch, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Allow to cool for a few minutes before transferring to plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: vanilla whey-based protein powder (containing 20 grams protein/serving)
